_notes: M2.6: fence cost = cost_per_segment x parcel outline edges (tile edges not shared with another tile of the same parcel: a 1x1 has 4, a 2x2 has 8, an L of 4 tiles has 10). segments_per_enclosure is the reference outline (a 1x1) that upkeep_per_quarter is quoted for; bigger parcels pay upkeep in proportion. Breakout rules: with the fence at or above the species' min tier, danger_level <= low_condition_danger_min - 1 never escapes; higher danger levels only roll once condition falls below low_condition_threshold (low_condition_chance_per_day x danger_factor). Below the min tier: base_chance_per_day x danger_factor[danger_level] x tiers short. Security multiplies by (1 - its effect_magnitude). Condition decays condition_loss_per_quarter each quarter; maintenance coverage cuts that by its effect_magnitude. Playtest-2 fix: quarterly decay 6 -> 4 and storm fence_damage cut ~20% in events.json, because a maintained electrified T-rex pen was ending year 1 at condition 31 against a low_condition_threshold of 30 - one more storm and a player who had done everything right started taking escapes. Playtest-3 fix: maintenance_repair_per_quarter is what a fully staffed maintenance crew PUTS BACK each quarter (scaled by pen coverage), so storm damage no longer accumulates on a park that is properly staffed; big damage still needs the Repair button, but a maintained pen keeps a real margin above low_condition_threshold across a year.
